profile.headline: Senior Lead Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary:
•.     9+ years of IT industry experience encompassing a wide range of skill set, roles and industry verticals. 
•	Extensive experience with analysis, design, development, customization and implementation of software applications. 
•	Proficient in analyzing and translating business requirements to technical requirements and architecture.
•	Transforming the client’s business requirements into Java based code modules.
•	Migrated .NET based legacy systems to Java based micro services on Amazon Web Services under tight timelines.
•	Contributed to all technical aspects of the efforts to migrate the legacy web services to Java based micro services hosted on AWS.
•	Extensively working on Java and spring boot based micro services.
•	Working on Apigee flows for API request management.
•	Developing Angular based UI for internal tools and applications.
•	Designing solutions on AWS using various AWS services (ECS, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM).
•	Designed and delivered complex software projects for Healthcare Industry.
•	Strong database skills, Object Oriented Programming and development knowledge
•	Experience in developing applications and supporting project applications as an ‘Senior Application Developer/Technical Lead’.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Extensively working on designing and developing new solutions on AWS cloud platform to support various consumer facing applications.
•	Developed complex Java Microservices on Spring-boot.
•	Experience in working with Enterprise Architects and Business stakeholders to design the solution as per the requirements.
•	Leading team members to implement the solution as per the design and deliver quality code as per the coding standards, technical and business requirements. 
•	Designed applications on AWS using EC2, ECS, ALB, S3, Lambda, RDS Aurora, CloudWatch, IAM, VPC. 
•	Developed microservices which interact with databases like Mongo DB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch.
•	Developed custom logging applications using Elasticsearch and Kibana.
•	Developed .NET/C# applications (web services and console applications).
•	Designed and developed custom workflows to handle transactional data involving PostgreSQL and DB2.
•	Developed Angular based web application for internal tools and applications.
•	Develop design documentations for the applications.
•	Experience and knowledge of Agile methodologies.
•	Working with Technical Operations team to debug and resolve issues reported in Production.
positions.insights: Java, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +4 skills

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Extensively worked on migrating .NET/C# based webservices to Java based microservices (hosted on AWS).
•	Lead other team members to meet the code delivery timelines while meeting technical requirements and following coding standards.
•	Worked with Client to transform business requirements into technical requirements.
•	Contributed to all technical aspects of the efforts to migrate the legacy web services to Java based micro services hosted on AWS.
•	Responsible for training and mentoring new team members. 
•	Developed custom ticketing application for tracking issues in microservices.
•	Worked on RabbitMQ for implementing message-broker based workflows.
•	Developed custom data loading applications to load data into MongoDB using SQL SSIS packages and AWS S3.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for building monitoring and error logging applications to handle 2 million plus daily transactions.
•	Developed .NET/C# and XLST based webservices which interacted with various backends like SQL, DB2, Oracle and other webservices.
•	Extensively worked on migrating .NET/C# based webservices to Java based microservices (hosted on AWS).
•	Worked with other team members to deliver the new application on time to Production.
